```{r life-expectancy-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

life_exp <- read_csv("LifeExpData.csv")

# year columns are named "1960", "1961" etc — pivot to long so we can plot over time
life_exp_long <- life_exp %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^[0-9]{4}$"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Life_Expectancy"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

# narrow down to top 10 to keep the chart readable
top_codes <- life_exp_long %>%
  group_by(Country_Code) %>%
  summarise(avg_life = mean(Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice_max(avg_life, n = 10) %>%
  pull(Country_Code)

life_exp_subset <- life_exp_long %>%
  filter(Country_Code %in% top_codes)

ggplot(life_exp_subset, aes(x = Year, y = Life_Expectancy, color = Country_Code)) +
  geom_line(size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Life Expectancy Over Time (Top 10 Countries by Average)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Life Expectancy",
    color = "Country Code"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r life-expectancy-heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

life_exp <- read_csv("LifeExpData.csv")

life_exp_long <- life_exp %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^[0-9]{4}$"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Life_Expectancy"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

# 30 countries gives enough variety without making the heatmap unreadable
top_countries <- life_exp_long %>%
  group_by(Country_Code) %>%
  summarise(avg_life = mean(Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice_max(avg_life, n = 30) %>%
  pull(Country_Code)

filtered_data <- life_exp_long %>%
  filter(Country_Code %in% top_countries)

# plasma palette works well for life expectancy — lower values stand out clearly
ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Year, y = Country_Code, fill = Life_Expectancy)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(
    title = "Heatmap of Life Expectancy by Country and Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Country",
    fill = "Life Expectancy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))
```
